---
title: "Model-iteration-7 (tuned ensemble)"
format: html
---

Model 7: aim for the best honest score.
Full feature set (Model 4 + venue x player + batting position, all built in this file),
hyperparameters chosen by random search on grouped CV (training matches only),
then an average of the top configurations over several seeds.
The test set is used once, at the end. Target = any wicket (`wickets`).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(xgboost)
library(yardstick)
library(here)
library(shapviz)
library(gt)
```

Read data, keep innings 1 and 2

```{r}
target_col <- "wickets"

bbl_inn <- readRDS(here("Pranav", "data", "bbl_t20_data.rds")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(innings %in% c(1, 2))
```

Chronological cutoff, identical to Models 3 to 6. League priors use training matches only.

```{r}
match_dates <- bbl_inn |>
  filter(shortened_match == 0) |>
  distinct(match_id, start_date) |>
  arrange(start_date, match_id)

cutoff_index <- floor(nrow(match_dates) * 0.8)
cutoff_date  <- match_dates$start_date[cutoff_index]

train_match_ids <- match_dates |> filter(start_date <= cutoff_date) |> pull(match_id)
match_lookup    <- bbl_inn |> distinct(match_id, start_date, venue)
```

Player-identity features (as in Model 4)

```{r}
K_bat  <- 120
K_bowl <- 150

bat_faced <- bbl_inn |>
  group_by(match_id, striker) |>
  summarise(balls = sum(ifelse(is.na(wides), 1, 0)), .groups = "drop")

bat_out <- bbl_inn |>
  filter(wickets == 1, !is.na(player_dismissed)) |>
  group_by(match_id, striker = player_dismissed) |>
  summarise(dism = n(), .groups = "drop")

bat_match <- full_join(bat_faced, bat_out, by = c("match_id", "striker")) |>
  left_join(match_lookup, by = "match_id") |>
  mutate(balls = coalesce(balls, 0), dism = coalesce(dism, 0))

league_bat <- bat_match |> filter(match_id %in% train_match_ids) |>
  summarise(r = sum(dism) / sum(balls)) |> pull(r)

bat_rate <- bat_match |>
  arrange(striker, start_date, match_id) |>
  group_by(striker) |>
  mutate(b = lag(cumsum(balls), default = 0),
         d = lag(cumsum(dism),  default = 0),
         sk_bat_dismissal_rate = (d + K_bat * league_bat) / (b + K_bat)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(match_id, striker, sk_bat_dismissal_rate)

bowl_match <- bbl_inn |>
  group_by(match_id, start_date, bowler) |>
  summarise(balls = sum(legal_ball), wkts = sum(bowler_wicket), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(select(match_lookup, match_id, venue), by = "match_id")

league_bowl <- bowl_match |> filter(match_id %in% train_match_ids) |>
  summarise(r = sum(wkts) / sum(balls)) |> pull(r)

bowl_rate <- bowl_match |>
  arrange(bowler, start_date, match_id) |>
  group_by(bowler) |>
  mutate(b = lag(cumsum(balls), default = 0),
         w = lag(cumsum(wkts),  default = 0),
         sk_bowl_wicket_rate = (w + K_bowl * league_bowl) / (b + K_bowl)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(match_id, bowler, sk_bowl_wicket_rate)
```

Venue and venue x player features (as in Model 5)

```{r}
K_venue <- 1200
K_bv    <- 60
K_wv    <- 100

venue_match <- bbl_inn |>
  group_by(match_id, start_date, venue) |>
  summarise(balls = sum(legal_ball), wkts = sum(wickets), .groups = "drop")

league_venue <- venue_match |> filter(match_id %in% train_match_ids) |>
  summarise(r = sum(wkts) / sum(balls)) |> pull(r)

venue_rate <- venue_match |>
  arrange(venue, start_date, match_id) |>
  group_by(venue) |>
  mutate(b = lag(cumsum(balls), default = 0),
         w = lag(cumsum(wkts),  default = 0),
         sk_venue_wicket_rate = (w + K_venue * league_venue) / (b + K_venue)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(match_id, sk_venue_wicket_rate)

bat_venue <- bat_match |>
  arrange(striker, venue, start_date, match_id) |>
  group_by(striker, venue) |>
  mutate(vb = lag(cumsum(balls), default = 0),
         vd = lag(cumsum(dism),  default = 0)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(bat_rate, by = c("match_id", "striker")) |>
  mutate(sk_bat_at_venue_rate = (vd + K_bv * sk_bat_dismissal_rate) / (vb + K_bv),
         bat_venue_effect     = sk_bat_at_venue_rate - sk_bat_dismissal_rate) |>
  select(match_id, striker, sk_bat_at_venue_rate, bat_venue_effect)

bowl_venue <- bowl_match |>
  arrange(bowler, venue, start_date, match_id) |>
  group_by(bowler, venue) |>
  mutate(vb = lag(cumsum(balls), default = 0),
         vw = lag(cumsum(wkts),   default = 0)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(bowl_rate, by = c("match_id", "bowler")) |>
  mutate(sk_bowl_at_venue_rate = (vw + K_wv * sk_bowl_wicket_rate) / (vb + K_wv),
         bowl_venue_effect     = sk_bowl_at_venue_rate - sk_bowl_wicket_rate) |>
  select(match_id, bowler, sk_bowl_at_venue_rate, bowl_venue_effect)
```

Batting position features (as in Model 5)

```{r}
K_pos <- 3

appear <- bbl_inn |>
  group_by(match_id, innings) |>
  mutate(seq = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(match_id, innings, seq, striker, non_striker) |>
  pivot_longer(c(striker, non_striker), names_to = "role", values_to = "player") |>
  mutate(key = seq * 2L + if_else(role == "striker", 1L, 2L))

position <- appear |>
  group_by(match_id, innings, player) |>
  summarise(first_key = min(key), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(match_id, innings, first_key) |>
  group_by(match_id, innings) |>
  mutate(position = row_number()) |>
  ungroup()

pos_match <- position |>
  select(match_id, striker = player, position) |>
  left_join(select(match_lookup, match_id, start_date), by = "match_id")

league_pos <- pos_match |> filter(match_id %in% train_match_ids) |>
  summarise(m = mean(position)) |> pull(m)

pos_hist <- pos_match |>
  arrange(striker, start_date, match_id) |>
  group_by(striker) |>
  mutate(n_b = row_number() - 1,
         s_b = lag(cumsum(position), default = 0),
         striker_usual_position = (s_b + K_pos * league_pos) / (n_b + K_pos)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(match_id, striker, striker_usual_position)

pos_now <- position |>
  select(match_id, innings, striker = player, striker_position = position)
```

Join everything (row count must not change), then apply the Model 3 filters

```{r}
n0 <- nrow(bbl_inn)

bbl_all <- bbl_inn |>
  left_join(bat_rate,    by = c("match_id", "striker")) |>
  left_join(bowl_rate,   by = c("match_id", "bowler")) |>
  left_join(venue_rate,  by = "match_id") |>
  left_join(bat_venue,   by = c("match_id", "striker")) |>
  left_join(bowl_venue,  by = c("match_id", "bowler")) |>
  left_join(pos_now,     by = c("match_id", "innings", "striker")) |>
  left_join(pos_hist,    by = c("match_id", "striker")) |>
  mutate(striker_pos_diff = striker_position - striker_usual_position)

stopifnot(nrow(bbl_all) == n0)

bbl_all <- bbl_all |>
  filter(shortened_match == 0) |>
  mutate(
    phase_Powerplay = as.integer(phase == "Powerplay"),
    phase_Middle    = as.integer(phase == "Middle"),
    phase_Death     = as.integer(phase == "Death")
  )
```

Feature set: everything from Models 4 and 5

```{r}
base_cols <- c(
  "innings", "over_no", "balls_remaining", "score_before",
  "wickets_lost_before", "required_runs", "free_hit",
  "bowler_balls_bowled_before", "bowler_economy_before",
  "bowler_boundary_p_before", "bowler_dot_ball_p_before",
  "batsman_runs_scored_before", "batsman_balls_faced_before",
  "batsman_strike_rate_before", "batsman_boundary_p_before",
  "career_matches_before", "career_batting_avg_before",
  "career_bowling_strike_rate_before", "career_batting_strike_rate_before",
  "career_boundary_p_before", "career_matches_bowled_before",
  "career_economy_before", "career_bowling_avg_before", "career_dot_p_before",
  "phase_Powerplay", "phase_Middle", "phase_Death"
)

ratio_cols <- c("current_rr", "required_rr", "rr_gap", "resources",
                "runs_per_wkt_in_hand", "batsman_sr_vs_rr", "batter_new")

momentum_cols <- c("ball_in_over", "balls_since_wicket", "balls_since_boundary",
                   "runs_last_6", "runs_last_12", "dots_last_6", "dots_last_12",
                   "wkts_last_12", "bnds_last_12")

partnership_cols <- c("partnership_runs_before", "partnership_balls_before")
player_cols      <- c("sk_bat_dismissal_rate", "sk_bowl_wicket_rate")
venue_cols       <- c("sk_venue_wicket_rate", "sk_bat_at_venue_rate", "bat_venue_effect",
                      "sk_bowl_at_venue_rate", "bowl_venue_effect")
position_cols    <- c("striker_position", "striker_usual_position", "striker_pos_diff")

feature_cols <- c(base_cols, ratio_cols, momentum_cols, partnership_cols,
                  player_cols, venue_cols, position_cols)
length(feature_cols)
```

Select and split (same cutoff as before)

```{r}
model_data <- bbl_all |>
  select(match_id, start_date, all_of(feature_cols), all_of(target_col))

train_data <- model_data |> filter(start_date <= cutoff_date)
test_data  <- model_data |> filter(start_date >  cutoff_date)

y_train <- train_data[[target_col]]
y_test  <- test_data[[target_col]]

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(train_data |> select(all_of(feature_cols)) |> as.matrix(), label = y_train)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(test_data  |> select(all_of(feature_cols)) |> as.matrix(), label = y_test)

c(train_rows = nrow(train_data), test_rows = nrow(test_data),
  base_rate_train = mean(y_train), base_rate_test = mean(y_test))
```

Evaluation helper and grouped 5-fold CV folds 

```{r}
eval_preds <- function(truth, p) {
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, 1e-15), 1 - 1e-15)
  tibble(
    pr_auc  = pr_auc_vec(factor(truth, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second"),
    roc_auc = roc_auc_vec(factor(truth, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second"),
    logloss = -mean(truth * log(p) + (1 - truth) * log(1 - p)),
    brier   = mean((p - truth)^2)
  )
}

set.seed(35571381)
train_matches <- unique(train_data$match_id)
fold_of_match <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out = length(train_matches)))
folds <- lapply(1:5, function(k) {
  which(train_data$match_id %in% train_matches[fold_of_match == k])
})
```

Random search over hyperparameters, scored by grouped-CV PR-AUC on the training matches only.
Config 1 is Model 2's settings, as the reference. Lower `n_configs` if it runs too long.

```{r}
n_configs <- 20
set.seed(35571381)

configs <- bind_rows(
  tibble(max_depth = 6, min_child_weight = 5, lambda = 1, alpha = 0, gamma = 0,
         subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8),
  tibble(
    max_depth        = sample(2:7, n_configs, replace = TRUE),
    min_child_weight = round(exp(runif(n_configs, log(1), log(100)))),
    lambda           = exp(runif(n_configs, log(0.5), log(50))),
    alpha            = runif(n_configs, 0, 5),
    gamma            = runif(n_configs, 0, 5),
    subsample        = runif(n_configs, 0.5, 1),
    colsample_bytree = runif(n_configs, 0.3, 1)
  )
) |> mutate(id = row_number(), .before = 1)

tune <- pmap_dfr(configs, function(id, max_depth, min_child_weight, lambda, alpha,
                                   gamma, subsample, colsample_bytree) {
  p <- list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "aucpr", eta = 0.05,
            max_depth = max_depth, min_child_weight = min_child_weight,
            lambda = lambda, alpha = alpha, gamma = gamma,
            subsample = subsample, colsample_bytree = colsample_bytree)

  cv <- xgb.cv(params = p, data = dtrain, nrounds = 1500, folds = folds,
               early_stopping_rounds = 30, verbose = 0, maximize = TRUE)
  lg <- cv$evaluation_log
  b  <- which.max(lg$test_aucpr_mean)

  message(sprintf("config %d of %d: grouped-CV PR-AUC %.4f (%d rounds)",
                  id, n_configs + 1, lg$test_aucpr_mean[b], lg$iter[b]))

  tibble(id, max_depth, min_child_weight, lambda, alpha, gamma, subsample,
         colsample_bytree, nrounds = lg$iter[b], cv_pr = lg$test_aucpr_mean[b])
})

tune |> arrange(desc(cv_pr)) |> print(n = 10)
tune |> filter(id == 1) |> select(id, cv_pr)    # Model 2's settings, for reference
```

Final models: top configurations, each trained with several seeds on all training matches, predictions averaged

```{r}
n_top <- 3
seeds <- c(1, 2, 3)

top <- tune |> arrange(desc(cv_pr)) |> slice_head(n = n_top)

models <- map(seq_len(n_top), function(j) {
  cfg <- top[j, ]
  p <- list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "aucpr", eta = 0.05,
            max_depth = cfg$max_depth, min_child_weight = cfg$min_child_weight,
            lambda = cfg$lambda, alpha = cfg$alpha, gamma = cfg$gamma,
            subsample = cfg$subsample, colsample_bytree = cfg$colsample_bytree)
  map(seeds, function(s) {
    xgb.train(params = c(p, list(seed = s)), data = dtrain,
              nrounds = cfg$nrounds, verbose = 0)
  })
}) |> unlist(recursive = FALSE)

pred_list  <- map(models, ~ predict(.x, dtest))
pred_probs <- Reduce(`+`, pred_list) / length(pred_list)
```

Match-level bootstrap for Model 7
```{r}

set.seed(35571381)

idx_by_match <- split(seq_len(nrow(test_data)), test_data$match_id)

boot_auc <- map_dfr(1:200, function(i) {
  m <- sample(names(idx_by_match), replace = TRUE)
  idx <- unlist(idx_by_match[m], use.names = FALSE)

  eval_preds(y_test[idx], pred_probs[idx])
})

```

Calibration

```{r}
calibration <- tibble(pred = pred_probs, actual = y_test) |>
  mutate(bucket = ntile(pred, 10)) |>
  group_by(bucket) |>
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(pred), mean_actual = mean(actual), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
calibration
```


Test-set performance and results
```{r}
# Deciles of predicted risk (10 = the riskiest 10% of deliveries)
dec <- tibble(match_id = test_data$match_id, pred = pred_probs, actual = y_test) |>
  mutate(decile = ntile(pred, 10),
         top5   = pred >= quantile(pred, 0.95))

presentation_stats <- function(d) {
  overall <- mean(d$actual)
  top10   <- d$decile == 10
  tibble(
    overall_wicket_rate              = overall,
    deliveries_per_wicket_overall    = 1 / overall,
    top_decile_wicket_rate           = mean(d$actual[top10]),
    top_decile_lift                  = mean(d$actual[top10]) / overall,
    top_decile_share_of_wickets      = sum(d$actual[top10]) / sum(d$actual),
    top_decile_deliveries_per_wicket = 1 / mean(d$actual[top10]),
    top_3_deciles_share_of_wickets   = sum(d$actual[d$decile >= 8]) / sum(d$actual),
    bottom_decile_wicket_rate        = mean(d$actual[d$decile == 1]),
    top_5pct_wicket_rate             = mean(d$actual[d$top5])
  )
}


boot_pres <- map_dfr(1:1000, function(i) {
  m   <- sample(names(idx_by_match), replace = TRUE)       # resample whole matches
  idx <- unlist(idx_by_match[m], use.names = FALSE)
  presentation_stats(dec[idx, ])
})

pres_table <- presentation_stats(dec) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metric", values_to = "estimate") |>
  left_join(boot_pres |> pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metric") |>
              group_by(metric) |>
              summarise(lo = quantile(value, 0.025), hi = quantile(value, 0.975)),
            by = "metric")

# PR-AUC and ROC-AUC with their intervals 
model_metrics <- eval_preds(y_test, pred_probs)

auc_table <- tibble(
  metric = c("pr_auc", "roc_auc"),
  estimate = c(model_metrics$pr_auc, model_metrics$roc_auc),
  lo = c(
    quantile(boot_auc$pr_auc, 0.025),
    quantile(boot_auc$roc_auc, 0.025)
  ),
  hi = c(
    quantile(boot_auc$pr_auc, 0.975),
    quantile(boot_auc$roc_auc, 0.975)
  )
)

headline_metrics <- bind_rows(auc_table, pres_table)
headline_metrics

# Total wickets: predicted vs actual, and the same by phase of play
c(predicted_wickets = sum(pred_probs), actual_wickets = sum(y_test))

# Plot A: actual wicket rate by decile of predicted risk
p_decile <- dec |>
  group_by(decile) |>
  summarise(wicket_rate = mean(actual), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(decile), wicket_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(dec$actual), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Decile of predicted wicket risk (10 = riskiest)", y = "Actual wicket rate",
       title = "Actual wicket rate by predicted-risk decile",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = overall wicket rate in the test set")

# Plot B: cumulative share of wickets captured as more deliveries are flagged
p_cumulative <- dec |>
  arrange(desc(pred)) |>
  mutate(pct_deliveries = row_number() / n(), pct_wickets = cumsum(actual) / sum(actual)) |>
  ggplot(aes(pct_deliveries, pct_wickets)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, colour = "grey60") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Share of deliveries flagged (riskiest first)", y = "Share of all wickets captured",
       title = "Wickets captured by flagging the riskiest deliveries",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = flagging at random")
```


Xai for the model

```{r}
set.seed(35571381)
samp_idx <- sample(nrow(test_data), 5000)          # sample keeps the plots quick
X <- test_data[samp_idx, ] |> select(all_of(feature_cols)) |> as.matrix()

contrib <- Reduce(`+`, map(models, ~ predict(.x, X, predcontrib = TRUE))) / length(models)
stopifnot(ncol(contrib) == length(feature_cols) + 1)       # features + bias

S  <- contrib[, seq_along(feature_cols), drop = FALSE]
colnames(S) <- feature_cols
sv <- shapviz(S, X = as.data.frame(X), baseline = contrib[1, ncol(contrib)])

# Feature groups for the headline plot
state_cols <- c("innings", "over_no", "balls_remaining", "score_before", "wickets_lost_before",
                "required_runs", "free_hit", "phase_Powerplay", "phase_Middle", "phase_Death",
                "current_rr", "required_rr", "rr_gap", "resources", "runs_per_wkt_in_hand")
batter_group <- c(grep("^batsman_", feature_cols, value = TRUE), "batter_new",
                  "career_matches_before", "career_batting_avg_before",
                  "career_batting_strike_rate_before", "career_boundary_p_before",
                  "sk_bat_dismissal_rate", position_cols)
bowler_group <- c(grep("^bowler_", feature_cols, value = TRUE), "career_matches_bowled_before",
                  "career_economy_before", "career_bowling_avg_before",
                  "career_bowling_strike_rate_before", "career_dot_p_before", "sk_bowl_wicket_rate")

groups <- list(match_state = state_cols, batter = batter_group, bowler = bowler_group,
               momentum = momentum_cols, partnership = partnership_cols, venue = venue_cols)

stopifnot(setequal(unlist(groups), feature_cols), anyDuplicated(unlist(groups)) == 0)

# Plot 1 (headline): how much each group of features moves the predictions
p_shap_groups <- imap_dfr(groups, ~ tibble(group = .y,
                          mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(rowSums(S[, .x, drop = FALSE]))))) |>
  ggplot(aes(reorder(group, mean_abs_shap), mean_abs_shap)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean |SHAP| (log-odds)")

# Plot 2: the 15 individual features that matter most, and which way they push
p_shap_beeswarm <- sv_importance(sv, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 15)

# Plot 3: how the risk changes with over, by wickets lost (SHAP dependence)
p_shap_dep_over <- sv_dependence(sv, "over_no", color_var = "wickets_lost_before")

# Plot 4: model prediction vs actual wicket rate, by over and innings
p_by_over <- test_data |>
  mutate(pred = pred_probs, actual = y_test,
         innings = factor(innings, levels = c(1, 2),
                          labels = c("Innings 1 (batting first)", "Innings 2 (chasing)"))) |>
  group_by(innings, over_no) |>
  summarise(predicted = mean(pred), actual = mean(actual), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(over_no)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, colour = "Model prediction")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = actual, colour = "Actual")) +
  facet_wrap(~ innings) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Over", y = "Wicket rate per delivery", colour = NULL,
       title = "Wicket rate by over: model vs actual")

# Plot 5: predicted wicket probability by over and wickets lost
p_heatmap  <- test_data |>
  mutate(pred = pred_probs) |>
  filter(wickets_lost_before <= 8) |>
  group_by(over_no, wickets_lost_before) |>
  summarise(pred = mean(pred), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(over_no, wickets_lost_before, fill = pred)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Over", y = "Wickets lost", fill = "P(wicket)")

# Plot 6: one delivery explained feature by feature (the riskiest ball in the sample)
p_waterfall <- sv_waterfall(sv, row_id = which.max(rowSums(S)), max_display = 10)
```


```{r}
base_rate <- mean(y_test)

# --- Table 1: headline metrics -------------------------------------------------
fmt_val <- function(x, fmt) {
  case_when(fmt == "pct"  ~ scales::percent(x, accuracy = 0.1),
            fmt == "num1" ~ sprintf("%.1f", x),
            fmt == "num2" ~ sprintf("%.2f", x),
            TRUE          ~ sprintf("%.3f", x))
}

metric_labels <- tribble(
  ~metric, ~group, ~label, ~meaning, ~fmt,
  "pr_auc", "Ranking quality", "PR-AUC",
    sprintf("How well wicket deliveries are ranked above the rest (no-skill value: %.3f)", base_rate), "num3",
  "roc_auc", "Ranking quality", "ROC-AUC",
    "Chance a random wicket delivery is rated riskier than a random non-wicket one (0.5 = no skill)", "num3",
  "overall_wicket_rate", "Overall wicket rate", "Overall wicket rate",
    "Share of all test deliveries that were wickets", "pct",
  "deliveries_per_wicket_overall", "Overall wicket rate", "Deliveries per wicket",
    "Average number of deliveries bowled per wicket", "num1",
  "top_decile_wicket_rate", "Riskiest 10% of deliveries", "Wicket rate",
    "Share of the riskiest 10% of deliveries that were wickets", "pct",
  "top_decile_lift", "Riskiest 10% of deliveries", "Top-decile lift",
    "Top-decile wicket rate divided by the overall wicket rate", "num2",
  "top_decile_share_of_wickets", "Riskiest 10% of deliveries", "Share of all wickets",
    "Fraction of all test wickets that fall in the riskiest 10%", "pct",
  "top_decile_deliveries_per_wicket", "Riskiest 10% of deliveries", "Deliveries per wicket",
    "Average deliveries per wicket within the riskiest 10%", "num1",
  "top_3_deciles_share_of_wickets", "Riskiest 30% / 5% / safest 10%", "Riskiest 30%: share of all wickets",
    "Fraction of all test wickets that fall in the riskiest 30%", "pct",
  "top_5pct_wicket_rate", "Riskiest 30% / 5% / safest 10%", "Riskiest 5%: wicket rate",
    "Share of the riskiest 5% of deliveries that were wickets", "pct",
  "bottom_decile_wicket_rate", "Riskiest 30% / 5% / safest 10%", "Safest 10%: wicket rate",
    "Share of the safest 10% of deliveries that were wickets", "pct"
)

tbl_headline <- headline_metrics |>
  left_join(metric_labels, by = "metric") |>
  mutate(estimate_txt = fmt_val(estimate, fmt),
         interval_txt = paste0(fmt_val(lo, fmt), " to ", fmt_val(hi, fmt))) |>
  select(group, label, estimate_txt, interval_txt, meaning) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "group") |>
  cols_label(label = "Metric", estimate_txt = "Estimate",
             interval_txt = "95% interval", meaning = "What it means") |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(estimate_txt, interval_txt)) |>
  tab_header(title = "Model 7: headline test-set metrics",
             subtitle = "Intervals come from resampling whole matches") |>
  tab_source_note(sprintf("Test set: %s deliveries, %s wickets (%.1f%% of deliveries)",
                          format(length(y_test), big.mark = ","),
                          format(sum(y_test), big.mark = ","), 100 * base_rate))
tbl_headline

# --- Table 2: by decile of predicted risk --------------------------------------
tbl_decile <- dec |>
  group_by(decile) |>
  summarise(deliveries = n(), wickets = sum(actual),
            predicted_rate = mean(pred), actual_rate = mean(actual), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(decile)) |>
  mutate(lift = actual_rate / base_rate,
         share_of_wickets = wickets / sum(wickets),
         cumulative_share = cumsum(share_of_wickets),
         decile = case_when(decile == 10 ~ "10 (riskiest)",
                            decile == 1  ~ "1 (safest)",
                            TRUE ~ as.character(decile))) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(decile = "Decile of predicted risk", deliveries = "Deliveries", wickets = "Wickets",
             predicted_rate = "Predicted wicket rate", actual_rate = "Actual wicket rate",
             lift = "Lift", share_of_wickets = "Share of all wickets",
             cumulative_share = "Cumulative share") |>
  fmt_integer(c(deliveries, wickets)) |>
  fmt_percent(c(predicted_rate, actual_rate, share_of_wickets, cumulative_share), decimals = 1) |>
  fmt_number(lift, decimals = 2) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(rows = decile == "10 (riskiest)")) |>
  tab_header(title = "Wicket rate by decile of predicted risk") |>
  tab_source_note("Lift = the decile's actual wicket rate divided by the overall wicket rate. Cumulative share runs from the riskiest decile down.")
tbl_decile

# --- Table 3: by phase of play --------------------------------------------------
phase_levels <- c("Powerplay (overs 1-6)", "Middle (overs 7-16)", "Death (overs 17-20)")

phase_base <- test_data |>
  mutate(pred = pred_probs, actual = y_test,
         phase = case_when(phase_Powerplay == 1 ~ phase_levels[1],
                           phase_Middle == 1    ~ phase_levels[2],
                           TRUE                 ~ phase_levels[3]))

tbl_phase <- bind_rows(
  phase_base |> group_by(phase) |>
    summarise(deliveries = n(), predicted_wickets = sum(pred), actual_wickets = sum(actual), .groups = "drop"),
  phase_base |>
    summarise(phase = "All deliveries", deliveries = n(),
              predicted_wickets = sum(pred), actual_wickets = sum(actual))
) |>
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c(phase_levels, "All deliveries"))) |>
  arrange(phase) |>
  mutate(phase = as.character(phase),
         predicted_rate = predicted_wickets / deliveries,
         actual_rate = actual_wickets / deliveries,
         gap = predicted_rate - actual_rate) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(phase = "Phase", deliveries = "Deliveries",
             predicted_wickets = "Predicted wickets", actual_wickets = "Actual wickets",
             predicted_rate = "Predicted wicket rate", actual_rate = "Actual wicket rate",
             gap = "Predicted minus actual") |>
  fmt_integer(c(deliveries, predicted_wickets, actual_wickets)) |>
  fmt_percent(c(predicted_rate, actual_rate), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_percent(gap, decimals = 2, force_sign = TRUE) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(rows = phase == "All deliveries")) |>
  tab_header(title = "Predicted vs actual wickets by phase of play") |>
  tab_source_note("Predicted wickets = sum of the model's predicted probabilities over the deliveries in the phase.")
tbl_phase
```

               shap_groups = p_shap_groups, shap_beeswarm = p_shap_beeswarm,
               shap_dep_over = p_shap_dep_over, by_over = p_by_over,
               heatmap = p_heatmap, waterfall = p_waterfall),
  tables = list(headline = tbl_headline, decile = tbl_decile,
                phase = tbl_phase),
  numbers = list(base_rate = base_rate, n_test_rows = length(y_test),
                 n_test_wickets = sum(y_test), headline_metrics = headline_metrics),

)
